summary: Baidu, Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Hong Kong Exchange Next Day Disclosure Return dated September 25, 2026, disclosing on-market share repurchases of its Class A ordinary shares (HKEX 09888) under its existing buyback program. Between September 7 and September 25, 2026, the company repurchased roughly 8.47 million shares at prices ranging from about HKD 84.88 to HKD 92.38 per share, each tranche representing approximately 0.025% of issued shares, with shares bought for cancellation but not yet cancelled. No board recommendation or advisor was named. The buyback reduces share count modestly while preserving the US ADR/HK dual-listed structure. Watch execution pace and whether repurchases continue at current price levels as a signal of management's valuation view.
